title: Sword of Destiny
author: Andrzej Sapkowski
summary: A collection of stories about Geralt, a monster hunter for hire, who often finds that people are the worse beasts. Several retell familiar fairy tales with a cynical bite, and the last begins the larger saga.
readIf: you like sharp, sardonic fantasy stories that twist fairy tales and keep things grounded.
skipIf: you want a single continuous plot, since most of this is episodic.

pairings.reason: The first Witcher story collection, which introduces Geralt and the world.
A gritty, funny fantasy with a similar mix of wit and moral ambiguity.
A lighter, more comic fantasy about aging mercenaries looking back on their glory days.
